entities.name: Desert Nomads of Rabiah
entities.description: Wanderers of the dunes of Rabiah, experts at surviving the deadly desert climate.

entities.name: Red Taysir
entities.description: Most famous of the nomads and a future planeswalker who lived in the Karun Desert and left his version of Rabiah.

entities.name: Apprentice Taysir
entities.description: The Black-Green Apprentice, soul brother of Red Taysir, who gave him the Ring of Maruf.

entities.name: Nailah
entities.description: Sorceress Queen encountered by Taysir in the Karun Desert.

entities.name: Karun Desert
entities.description: Desert where the Red Taysir lived.

entities.name: Ring of Maruf
entities.description: Ring that Taysir used to leave his version of Rabiah.

events.summary: In the Karun Desert, Red Taysir encountered his soul brother Apprentice Taysir and Sorceress Queen Nailah.
events.quote: he encountered his soul brother, the Black-Green Apprentice Taysir, and the Sorceress Queen Nailah

events.summary: Apprentice Taysir gave Nomad Taysir the Ring of Maruf, which he used to leave his version of Rabiah forever.
events.quote: Apprentice Taysir gave Nomad Taysir the Ring of Maruf , which he used to leave his version of Rabiah behind forever.

relations.quote: The most famous member of these nomads was the Red Taysir
he encountered his soul brother, the Black-Green Apprentice Taysir
